title: The Slow Wardrobe
author: Orsen Underhill
blurb: Juniper Sandoval, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
